The '''Otolla''' lineage of [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] was the race that [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], [[Augara Jowil/Legends|Augara Jowil]], and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Roos Tarpals/Legends|Roos Tarpals]] belonged to, along with the majority of the Gungan [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Otolla species had long ears and eyes on extendable and retractable stalks, unlike the [[Ankura/Legends|Ankura]] Gungans (of whom [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Boss Nass]] was an example) who had hooded eyes, green skin, and wide, broad heads. Otolla skin was either orange or purple in hue.

The Otolla had been distant and separate from the Ankuras until [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]], an Ankuran, and [[Marsune (Gungan)|Marsune]], an Otolla, were united against [[Rogoe/Legends|Rogoe]] and later founded [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] which brought all of the Gungans together in a unified community, under the [[Gungan High Council/Legends|Gungan High Council]].
